candidates.change_summary: Change the condition so winner branch triggers when random == 1 instead of random == 0, altering when pot is reset.
Remove the pot increment so pot is not increased by msg.value on play, changing final pot value.
Move the pot reset before transferring to the winner so pot becomes 0 prior to transfers, changing observed pot after play.

Change fee transfer amount to 0 so pot remains larger after play if winner branch executes (pot set to 0 still occurs but transfers differ affecting intermediate state); keeps pot reset but alters transfer behavior that can affect reentrancy-visible pot in some cases.
Set pot to pot - FEE_AMOUNT instead of zero when winner branch executes, leaving a reduced pot after play.
Change the required ticket amount check from equality to inequality (require msg.value != TICKET_AMOUNT), allowing any value except 10 and thus altering pot updates and payouts.
Increment pot by only the fee amount instead of the full msg.value, changing the pot state after play calls and thus subsequent observable payouts.
Remove resetting pot to zero after a win (delete pot = 0), so pot remains and affects future play outcomes and observable pot value.
Change the winner condition to random == 1 instead of random == 0, flipping which random outcome triggers payouts and pot reset.
Transfer the fee to msg.sender instead of the bank, altering balances and observable behavior after play.
